title: Roy Edward Larsen Research Professor of Education and Human Development Professor of Psychology, Psychiatry Dept., Harvard Medical School
bio: The founder of HGSE's Prevention Science and Practice Program, Robert Selman participates with students to study the development of social awareness in youth as it relates to educational achievement, ethical development, and youth participation in old and new media.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
